title: Turbo Jumbo configuration
description: Configuration for the Turbo Jumbo model manager (config.yaml).

peers.description: Machines that share models, including this one. The local peer is the one whose address host matches this machine's IP.

address.description: host:port the peer serves on. For IPv6, bracket the host, e.g. "[2001:db8::1]:3000".

base_path.description: Directory containing the model subdirectories. Required for the local peer.

cold_storage_path.description: Cold-storage (archival) model directory. Required for the local peer.
